profileText: a Representative from New York; born in New York, Bronx County, N.Y., March 12, 1988; graduated from Herbert H. Lehman High School, New York City, N.Y., 2006; attended New York University, New York City, N.Y., 2006-2007; civil servant; community organizer; member of the New York, N.Y., city council, 2014-2020; Delegate, Democratic National Convention, 2016; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Seventeenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2021-present).
